I am so happy I found Kiss N Makeup and Christalee. I am a life long makeup junkie and to find a talented and experienced instructor in my backyard was a blessing. Chistalee is the BEST!! Whether you are looking to become a makeup artist or want to learn how to expertly apply your own makeup (yes, I can actually apply lashes now), this is the place to go.

Christalee Abreu, the Owner of Kiss and Makeup Artistry Academy is outstanding and a truly a hidden gem in Agoura!!!  This is truly someone who with all of her expertise on major films and television shows over a multi-year span, has perfected the face!!!  I love someone for example, in a clothing store who does not say "can I help you", because my answer would be most likely no, as they have immediately told me they don't get me!  I like this approach:  With your body type and your coloring, I have some great suggestions, try this, this, this, etc and they have you in the dressing room! Then they have my attention!!!  Christalee is that person!!! She can assess a face in mere seconds, to know exactly what to do to enhance it for a day look and/or glamorize it for a night look!  For me, glamour is a daily look that I prefer, but I would, even as a former make-up artist myself years back, like to get out of the rut and find a new way to update my look and Christalee is the one to do it!!!  I have seen her gallery.  Amazing work!!!  For you ladies, that also would like to find a way to put away the years, it is incredible, what she can accomplish that will make you look years younger with just a few techniques!!!  Many times that is what it takes, not the fillers and Botox, but knowing your face and finding the way through make-up artistry to bring out your best and play down what you do not think are your best features!!!  Bottom line, every woman has beauty and Christalee knows just how to bring it out!! This studio should ultimately be in major metropolitan cities all over the country, but there is only one Christalee and she cannot be everywhere!!!  Her credits are mind-blowing!!!  Christalee and her team who are taught her technique and personally mentored by her, are all phenomenal teachers!!!  For those of you, who want to move forward in the industry, there is none better and when you say, when applying for a show, who your teacher is or was (Christalee), that should get you a bigger nod for the job!!!  It is just like being an actress or actor and stating, I studied with The Actors Studio in New York City!!! That is clout; same thing here!!!  Yes location, location, location!!!  You may think  you have to go to Hollywood to get this type of training!!!  Don't let Agoura fool you!!!  Take advantage of Christalee's impeccable training!!!  Read some of the testimonials on the website!!!  That sold me!!!  A hidden treasure, that won't be hiding for very long!!! Discover the magic of knowing how to do the techniques that she studied years for in six classes!!!  I love her!!!
Completely wonderful experience!  This school is professional and Christa brings years of stage and screen experience. To her school and instructors!

Let me start out by thanking Ms. Christalee for not only teaching me techniques I never imagined I could master but also for her patience in doing so. This was an amazing learning experience and it was very personal with a lot of one on one time with only 4 students per class. I walked away from this class confident in my makeup application techniques and with more knowledge than I could ever have imagined. If I could give more than 5 stars I would because I cannot even begin to measure this experience with only 5 stars. I am thoroughly satisfied and recommend this class to anyone looking to further their career in the makeup industry. Traveling from Georgia to take this class was well worth it!! Thank you so much!!
Christalee is awesome!!! You can’t get this type of one on one in any other school!
